kind: machine_config (pre-registration; runner re-captures live into LIFECYCLE_RESULTS.json and must match)
continuity_with_P0: Same substrate as RNN-06-P0 (torch 2.6.0+cu124, transformers 4.48.3, no mamba_ssm/causal_conv1d, bf16). P0 used chunk_size=32 for feasibility of a long graded sweep; 06A default chunk_size is the model's native 256 (see PRE_REGISTRATION section 9) because 06A prefixes are short (<= chunk_size), so no chunk tiling occurs and no feasibility override is required. chunk_size dependence is tested as a declared sub-experiment, not silently changed.

determinism_controls.note: Mamba2 torch_forward has no dropout; eval+no_grad. Bit-level run-to-run determinism of cuBLAS matmuls is expected but NOT assumed; claim A predeclares a NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT fallback if not bit-exact.
